Copies of gs-check.mjs (tools/gs-check/) and gs-lock.mjs, gs-cochange.mjs, gs-redproof.mjs (tools/gs-lock/) from the formulas worktree (branch
formulas-2026-10-05), used only by the tests when those tools are not next to tools/gs-init/. The installer is pointed at this folder with --tools.
Delete this folder when the tools are merged beside gs-init. Never edit the copies.
